title: XMagicMouse
description:
Important NoteXMagicMouse is NOT a live wallpaper software,it can display mouse track and effect ANYWHERE, not only on desktop wallpaper. Compatible with other software etc. Wallpaper Engine,RainWallpaper.About XMagicMouseXMagicMouse is a funny and powerful mouse effect software that displays amazing animations and effects when you move your mouse or click anywhere.Features• Interactive simulation - molecules that react to the mouse movement and clicking.

• Workshop supported - one click download or share mouse effects.

• Many editing options - you can change almost every effects.

• Support Taskbar transparent

• Game Mode - will pause effects when you need 100% power for your games.

• Optimization - reduced equipment requirements. Optimized code created for Low-end devices.

• Multi-Language - includes 4 languages.

• Compatible with other software etc. Wallpaper Engine,RainWallpaper
